name: bult-ai-mcp-server
description: Deploy and manage Bult.ai cloud hosting projects from Claude Desktop.
long_description: Bult.ai MCP Server lets Claude Desktop deploy and manage Bult.ai cloud hosting resources. It can create projects and services, deploy GitHub repositories or Docker images, manage routes and volumes, inspect logs, and troubleshoot deployments.

tools.name: list-projects
tools.description: List Bult.ai hosting projects in the workspace so an AI agent can choose where to deploy, inspect status, or manage services.

tools.name: get-project
tools.description: Get a Bult project overview, including services, volumes, routes, deployment status, and public URL information.

tools.name: create-project
tools.description: Create a new Bult project for cloud hosting deployments from GitHub repositories, Docker images, templates, or databases.

tools.name: update-project
tools.description: Update a Bult project name to keep deployment and hosting workspaces organized.

tools.name: delete-project
tools.description: Delete a Bult project and all related cloud hosting resources, including services, routes, volumes, deployments, and public URLs.

tools.name: deploy-project
tools.description: Deploy pending Bult project changes, create a version snapshot, and make updated app services available on their public URLs.

tools.name: control-project
tools.description: Control a Bult project lifecycle by starting services, stopping cloud hosting resources, or discarding pending deployment changes.

tools.name: list-services
tools.description: List services in a Bult project, including app, database, GitHub repository, Docker image, and cloud hosting deployment targets.

tools.name: get-service
tools.description: Get Bult service details including deployment configuration, environment variables, ports, status, logs context, and public URL routing data.

tools.name: create-service
tools.description: Create a Bult.ai service. Supports daemon apps from a GitHub repository or Docker image, plus PostgreSQL, Redis, MySQL, and MongoDB database services.

tools.name: update-service
tools.description: Update a Bult service configuration, including deployment source, Docker image or GitHub repository settings, ports, files, and environment variables.

tools.name: delete-service
tools.description: Delete a Bult service and remove its cloud hosting deployment resources.

tools.name: control-service
tools.description: Control a Bult service lifecycle: start it, stop it, or rebuild it after deployment, Docker image, GitHub repository, or environment variable changes.

tools.name: create-route
tools.description: Create a Bult public route, generated URL, or custom domain mapping for a deployed service port.

tools.name: update-route
tools.description: Update a Bult route configuration, including public URL path, custom domain, service target, and exposed port.

tools.name: delete-route
tools.description: Delete a Bult public route or custom domain mapping from a deployed service.

tools.name: list-templates
tools.description: List available Bult app and database templates for fast cloud hosting setup and one-click deployments.

tools.name: apply-template
tools.description: Apply a Bult template to a project, creating preconfigured services, databases, volumes, routes, and deployable cloud hosting resources.

tools.name: get-service-logs
tools.description: Get Bult service logs with cursor-based pagination for debugging failed deployments, build errors, runtime issues, and cloud hosting status.

tools.name: list-builds
tools.description: List Bult service build and deployment history to inspect build status, failures, source revisions, and recent deploy activity.

tools.name: create-volume
tools.description: Create a persistent storage volume in a Bult project for deployed apps, databases, and cloud hosting services.

tools.name: update-volume
tools.description: Update a Bult persistent volume name or size for app storage and database hosting needs.

tools.name: delete-volume
tools.description: Delete a Bult persistent volume used by a deployed service or database.

tools.name: wipe-volume
tools.description: Irreversibly wipe all data from a Bult persistent volume used by cloud apps and databases.

bult_api_url.title: Bult API URL
bult_api_url.description: Base URL for Bult.ai API requests.

bult_api_token.title: Bult API Token
bult_api_token.description: API token from your Bult.ai account.
